# GeneratedAsset

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Generation` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public class GeneratedAsset : IDisposable
```

One finished asset. Owns its composited [`GeneratedAsset.Image`](Nfty.Core.Generation.GeneratedAsset.md#p-image): dispose the asset (or the [`GeneratedSet`](Nfty.Core.Generation.GeneratedSet.md) holding it) once the pixels have been written or drawn.
